create_knowledge_base: create a knowledge base entry with name, description, and optional access control for a given user
search_knowledge_bases: search knowledge bases by query string with pagination and filter by created or shared
search_knowledge_files: search files across all knowledge bases a user has read access to with filename filter and pagination
add_file_to_knowledge: add a file to a knowledge base by knowledge_id, file_id, and user_id
update_knowledge_by_id: update a knowledge base entry by id with new name, description, and access control settings
